public_rationale: The graph summarizes task-duration success thresholds and their change across model releases. It does not identify which particular questions computers reliably answer or predict when particular questions will be solved. This supports the ordinary question-specific reading. A stronger reading that the graph conveys no useful statistical information would not follow from this evidence.
limitations: The outcome depends on reading the claim as about specific questions.
The underlying study contains task-level observations and statistical relationships; those are not question-specific forecasts supplied by the graph.
This assessment does not establish that the aggregate metric is useless.
